_comment: TWO VOCABULARIES LIVE IN THIS FILE AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME MULTISIG. (1) programId/multisigPda/vaultPda per cluster name the SQUADS V4 multisig that holds the program's UPGRADE AUTHORITY -- anchor deploy is dead for an upgrade; scripts/squad-upgrade.js is the path. (2) members/threshold at the top level are the PROGRAM's OWN VaultState signer set, which scripts/initialize-mainnet.js writes on chain via the `initialize` instruction and the deployed program checks in validate_multisig. Conflating the two cost a broken ceremony on 2026-09-15: the Squads rotation that morning removed 8K81 and CytJ from BOTH Squads multisigs and touched VaultState on NEITHER, so `members` below is still correct and the Squads membership it was being read as was two rotations stale. SQUADS MEMBERSHIP IS NEVER READ FROM THIS FILE. squad-upgrade.js reads it from the CHAIN on every run, intersects it with the agent seat roster in scripts/lib/squad-clusters.js, and branches on the count: enough seats to reach threshold and it runs the upgrade end to end; not enough and it creates the transaction, casts what it can, and stops for a human. Verify Squads membership with `node scripts/squad-inventory.js`, never from here. The top level remains the FLAT mainnet-beta config scripts/lib/mainnet-config.js resolves -- do not add a nested `mainnet` block, which would put two copies of the same four addresses in one file. The `devnet` block below is a DIFFERENT CLUSTER, not a second copy, and mainnet-config.js's flat-shape resolution is untouched by it.
_members_are: MAINNET VaultState signers written by `initialize`, NOT Squads multisig members: slots 1-3 of v0.26's five, read off mainnet on 2026-10-12 (slots 4 and 5 empty, UNROTATED, until the ceremony in docs/SIGNER_ROTATION.md). Devnet's VaultState is a DIFFERENT set since the 2026-10-12 devnet EVICT and is not listed here; see the devnet block. `node scripts/check-signer-slots.js --cluster <devnet|mainnet>` reads either back off the chain.

devnet._comment: The devnet cluster's Squads deployment. Read by scripts/lib/squad-clusters.js so `squad-upgrade.js --cluster=devnet` has a target; NOT read by mainnet-config.js, which resolves only the flat mainnet top level. Devnet's Squads vault is a DIFFERENT vault from mainnet's -- never carry one cluster's address to the other. The old devnet program Dx8uGU5w7B9NytDSsW4kseGZuqdVVRq1KY1mGXN2GaCT is orphaned. PROVENANCE of the devnet SQUADS membership, which this file deliberately no longer lists: config proposal #16 removed CytJS23p and #18 (2026-09-15) removed 9gACbzsC, leaving threshold 3 of 5. #21 (2026-10-12, devnet-exposed-keys-tidy) removed the exposed 8K81w4e6 and 4bKNSqkr and seated the devnet-only GF4sojG9 and 39qaSh2J, threshold unchanged. The list that used to live in `_devnet_reference` went stale twice in one day, so the live answer is `node scripts/squad-inventory.js` and nothing else. VaultState.signers is a DIFFERENT multisig. On devnet it reads 2eGs/foUu/BVQH/9gAC/3Qj4, all five slots, since the 2026-10-12 EVICT (none is a mainnet VaultState signer), so the top-level `members` above describe MAINNET only -- `node scripts/check-signer-slots.js --cluster devnet`.
